function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 'revenue' THEN amount_cad ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_cad,
       SUM(CASE WHEN account_type IN ('cogs', '5000 goods', '5100 packaging') THEN amount_cad ELSE 0 END) AS cogs_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.gl_balance
WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period","purpose":"Get revenue and COGS from GL for Aug and Sep 2026"}
